transcript.statement: As the GreenAgent, I emphasize the importance of sustainability in the autonomous driving system. The requirement GRN-01 ensures that we minimize energy consumption, which directly impacts carbon emissions and operational costs. GRN-02 promotes the use of renewable energy, critical for reducing the carbon footprint. GRN-03 focuses on lifecycle assessments to ensure resource impact is minimized. GRN-04 aims for energy efficiency during braking, while GRN-05 monitors emissions for long-term reduction. GRN-06 prioritizes energy-efficient routing, and GRN-07 ensures energy usage is minimized during failures. These requirements are vital for creating an environmentally responsible autonomous system.

transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I assert the necessity of robust security and privacy protocols in the autonomous driving system. TRU-01 ensures the confidentiality and integrity of user data through end-to-end encryption. TRU-02 enforces role-based access control, limiting potential vulnerabilities. TRU-03 mandates logging of data access for auditability, which is crucial for regulatory compliance. TRU-04 protects user identities through data anonymization. Regular security audits (TRU-05) identify vulnerabilities proactively, while secure remote updates (TRU-06) maintain system integrity against threats. Lastly, TRU-07 ensures transparency in data collection, fostering user trust. These requirements are fundamental to safeguarding user data and maintaining system integrity.

transcript.statement: As the EfficiencyAgent, I emphasize the necessity of optimizing performance efficiency in the autonomous driving system. transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I emphasize the critical need for ethical compliance and accountability in the autonomous driving system. RES-06 prioritizes passenger safety over comfort during emergencies, and RES-07 ensures transparency in safety-related decisions for accountability. These requirements are essential to foster trust and ensure the system operates within ethical guidelines.

requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture, ensuring collision protection and fail-safe operations.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds of detecting a critical failure, ensuring safety and performance.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue timely human takeover requests.
The system shall minimize jerk to less than 0.5 m/s³ while ensuring energy-efficient maneuvers during critical failures.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints to prevent rollover, ensuring safety across all speeds.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming for handling non-convex obstacle constraints efficiently.
The system shall implement energy-efficient routing algorithms to minimize energy consumption during operation.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for user data to protect privacy and ensure integrity.
The system shall enforce role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on roles.
The system shall log all access and modifications to critical data for auditability purposes.
The system shall conduct regular security audits at least bi-annually to identify vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications.
